comparison.objective: Land a container on twistlocks and lock them; unlike adjusting a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-object alignment and landing followed by lock rotation; no recessed setscrew engagement, fine damping adjustment, or response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Container must be landed and both twistlocks turned, followed by arm retreat. Alignment tolerances and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both include rotation and locking, container registration and twistlock closure test different mechanics.
